Rishi / team — reviewed the scope and CedarLane's ask. I approve a conditional 30k-token isolation grant with these mandatory preconditions:

1) Signed security attestation from CedarLane's security lead confirming: KMS-backed key management, enforced SSO via SAML/OIDC, encryption at-rest for the evaluation dataset, and a retention/archival policy for logs (minimum 90 days).
2) Temporary access limited to CedarLane's named pilot engineers (we need a list of user principals).
3) Evidence deposit: a single ZIP containing the SOC2 evidence artifacts or auditor confirmation URL (Samir's audit report is fine). We will use our SOC2_evidence_checklist.pdf to validate.
4) No PHI export permitted outside the isolated environment during the trial period.

If CedarLane provides the attestation and the initial evidence URL within 7 days, proceed to issue 30k tokens now. The second tranche (30k) will be released after I confirm the evidence aligns with our checklist. I'll attach the checklist to this internal note for reference.

I'll cc the security reviewer on their evidence review when it arrives.
